data: Microsoft's gross profit was about 1.98 times NVIDIA's in fiscal 2025. Microsoft reported $193,893 million (labelled "gross margin" in its income statement) for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, on revenue of $281,724 million. NVIDIA reported $97,858 million for the fiscal year ended January 26, 2025, on revenue of $130,497 million. The two fiscal years do not line up, since NVIDIA's ended about five months before Microsoft's. NVIDIA's gross margin percentage was much higher, about 75.0% against Microsoft's roughly 68.8%. NVIDIA's gross profit also more than doubled from $44,301 million in fiscal 2024, while Microsoft's grew about 13% from $171,008 million.
